notes.en: New toon: Jay joins the Lovelings, with an animation (blue bird with a heart beak and a long tongue), his speech bubble and his name label. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: UniPops animations (Heli, Giggle, Bloop, Chili, Smooch, Razz) are cleaned up more: the thin white and grey lines and speed streaks around the toons are removed, so only the toon itself is left. Not yet tested on a real board.

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: Heli (UniPops) has new art and is now animated from your video. The white edge behind some UniPops animations (Giggle, Bloop, Chili) is removed, and the swirl lines around Giggle are gone. Not yet tested on a real board.

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: In the toon menu (the little eyes), a toon that needs you now shows a badge on its eye: a green cross when it is sick, a red exclamation mark when it wants something (food, play, sleep or a clean-up). Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: Three new ways to play. Tickle: rub your finger over the toon and it giggles and wiggles (too much and it gets dizzy). Peek-a-boo: now and then a tap makes the toon hide, tap again to make it pop out with a boo. Catch game: Play on the needs screen starts a 20 second game, tilt the device (or drag your finger) to catch the falling hearts and coins. Not yet tested on a real board. If the toon runs the wrong way when you tilt, tell me and I will flip it.

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: When a toon goes to sleep (Sleep on the needs screen) it now stays still in its rest pose with only slow breathing, no hopping or animation. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: The name of the toon now shows just under the eye, so you always know which toon you are playing with. A sad wah-wah sound plays when a toon turns sick (and green). Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: A toon that is ignored for 10 minutes, or is sick, now looks sick: green, slumped and wobbly, with green puffs above its head. Bored and angry still come first after 20 and 45 seconds. Also fixes the version number shown by the device. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: New Joylings toons: Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl and Wiggle, and Moo is now animated. The app area is bigger, so update once with the full image (full flash). Hold RESTART in Settings for 3 seconds to get a black screen (flash mode) so you can flash and update the device; a short tap still restarts to pair. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

joylings.name: Joylings (Moo, Bun, Dax, Flap, Slurp, Twirl, Wiggle)

notes.en: New setting CALLS (off, low, mid, high): how often the sleeping toon wakes up to ask for a play, food or a clean-up. Mid is every 5 to 15 minutes, high every 1.5 to 4 minutes. It repeats at the same pace when you do not answer, instead of getting slower. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: New row in settings: RESTART TO PAIR. It restarts the device with the Ready to pair screen, so you can pair it again. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: The toon now wakes up by itself when it wants something (hungry, bored, sick or poop). While it sleeps or rests the needs keep running slowly; every 10 to 30 minutes it opens its eye and peeps for 25 seconds. Tap to go to the toon, or it goes back to sleep. After 3 calls nobody answered it stops. It follows your sound setting, quiet hours and does not call below 15% battery. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: The Ready to pair message at start-up is gone: the eye opens straight away. Bluetooth is still on for 5 minutes after start-up. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: New care for every toon: after eating it poops (tap the poop to clean it up). If you neglect it, it gets sad and sick (tap the pill to give medicine). Three hearts under the toon show its care level. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: The zzz button moved next to the red eye, mirroring the WiFi icon. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: After the zzz button, a tap now opens the eye and then brings you back to the toon menu. The battery icon moved down under the text, so the top has three clean icons: WiFi, red eye and zzz. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: On battery the eye opens faster (shorter loading part of the start) to save battery. On USB or charging nothing changes. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: New zzz button on the toon menu: it says good night, switches the screen off and puts the device into light sleep to save battery. Tap the screen or press BOOT to wake it. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: Zig has new art and a new laughing animation. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: WiFi: a WiFi icon next to the red eye and a WiFi row in settings. Set the network on poptoons.fun/eye/pair in Chrome; the device then sets its clock from the internet and switches WiFi off again. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: Bluetooth pairing: after power-up the display shows READY TO PAIR. Open poptoons.fun/eye/pair in Chrome to set the clock, change settings and see the battery. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: Battery check: the Battery row on the settings page is always there. If no battery is read it says NO BATTERY (or NO POWER CHIP) and shows what the power chip reports. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: Battery status: charge percentage and charging bolt on the settings page, a small battery on the toon menu, and a blinking red battery when it is low. Reads the AXP2101 power chip and sets the charge current to 150 mA for the 310 mAh battery. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: New toon Jab (Monsterlings) with art, speech bubble and video animation. The toon picker has a third ring for more than 19 toons (with 20 toons the old one wrote outside its memory). Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: New toon Fang (Monsterlings) with art, speech bubble and video animation. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: Fixed: sounds, speech bubbles and hearts were switched off because the clock took the build time as the time of day (quiet time). Quiet time now stays off until the real time is known. Eye opening and turning the picture are faster (less tearing). Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch, Razz)

notes.en: New toon Razz (UniPops) with art, speech bubble and video animation. Toon limit raised to 20. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: Giggle and Smooch: removed the white patches that showed in some animation frames. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: New UniPops toon: Smooch, with a video animation (balloon and hearts included). If you flash All, use New device (full image) once. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle, Smooch)

notes.en: New UniPops toon: Giggle, with a video animation. Animated toons now take their menu picture from the first frame of the animation, which frees about 1 MB of flash. If you flash All, use New device (full image) once. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili, Giggle)

notes.en: New UniPops toon: Chili, with a video animation. Fix: the All build could hold only 12 toons and now holds 16 (older All builds with more than 12 toons could misbehave). If you flash All, use New device (full image) once. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli, Bloop, Chili)

notes.en: New Poopies toon: Drool, with a video animation. Burp now says its own line. If you flash All, use New device (full image) once because of the 8 MB app area. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: New Poopies toon: Chomp, with a video animation. The app area is now 8 MB so the All build fits: if you flash All, use New device (full image) once. Collection builds can still be updated as before. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: Poopies: new video animations for Buck (front teeth) and Burp. The crooked-teeth video now belongs to Snicker. Not yet tested on a real board.

notes.en: Choose a collection to flash: only its toons are installed (smaller and faster), or All toons. Buck (Poopies) has an animated body. Not yet tested on a real board.

unipops.name: UniPops (Heli)

notes.en: Buck (Poopies) now has an animated body: a squishing, hopping smile loop, 15 small frames. Not yet tested on a real board.
Sound volume setting: Off, Low, Mid, High (Mid is the old level, High is louder). Not yet tested on a real board.

Fix: short sounds (tap on the eye, blink) were cut off because the amplifier woke up too slowly. Amplifier now stays on, short sounds a bit longer and louder, chime at power on. Not yet tested on a real board.
Soft thump when a toon lands (after a hop or trick, or when a new toon pops in). Not yet tested on a real board.
Shaking a toon now has its own rattle sound. Not yet tested on a real board.
The whoosh is now a short swipe sound. Not yet tested on a real board.
New SOUND on/off row in settings (mute), whoosh when a toon hops, does a trick, poofs or shakes. Not yet tested on a real board.
Sounds: peep on tap, tiny blip on eye blink, pa-ping when a text bubble pops up (silent in quiet time). Not yet tested on a real board.
Sounds: a peep on every tap and a tiny blip when the eye blinks (silent in quiet time). Not yet tested on a real board.
Touch fixed (a resting finger now counts as pressed, so choosing a toon and tapping work), smoother animation (two cores draw in parallel, faster code). Not yet tested on a real board.
First version. Eye, toon picker, 8 toons, touch, shake, settings eye. Not yet tested on a real board.
